verdict.rationale: Algolia ships official open-source InstantSearch UI libraries, including InstantSearch.js and React InstantSearch, built from predefined widgets that can be configured, customized or replaced with custom widgets. The documented quickstart builds a search interface that searches, filters by product type and paginates, and the refinementList widget covers facets. Community users praise React InstantSearch as easy to add and note support across vanilla JS, React, Vue, Angular, iOS and Android. Missing for 10: explicit documentation naming the specific search-box, results/hits and pagination widgets (only facets via refinementList are named directly).

support.subject: As a developer, official UI component libraries let me assemble a full search interface — box, results, facets, pagination — without building it from scratch
